message.content: In the community discussion regarding the renovation of the garden, Arthas Menethil and Muradin Bronzebeard propose adding a small water feature and seating areas that blend well with the surroundings. Specifically, Arthas Menethil suggests adding a water feature such as a fountain to bring character to the garden and provide a relaxing sound, while Muradin Bronzebeard recommends incorporating native plants around the fountain to enhance its natural appearance and support local wildlife. Additionally, they suggest planting low-maintenance native plants and possibly adding some colorful annuals for visual appeal. Regarding the seating area, Muradin Bronzebeard proposes using stone benches, which are durable and blend well with the garden. These suggestions aim to create a serene and inviting environment for residents to relax and enjoy the garden. There is no mention of adding outdoor games specifically to the children's play area in this community discussion.
